stories.title: Cubs Win Game 2 — Series Headed to Sunday Rubber Match
stories.angle: PCA's go-ahead triple in the seventh. Nico Hoerner's 6th HR tied it first. Trent Thornton (4-4) picked up the win. Michael Busch added insurance in the 8th.
